It's pretty shoddy, so don't expect it to last very long.|Inventory|TotK}} Boko Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 5 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Boko Shield}} Boko Shields are [[Bokoblin]]-made [[Shield]]s that are made by attaching a handle to a flat piece of bark. Due to the low level of craftsmanship that went into them, they do not last very long in combat. They are commonly wielded by regular Bokoblins in [[Hyrule Field]], particularly on the [[Great Plateau]], as well as in [[West Necluda]]. These Shields are part of the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all [[Weapon]]s created by Bokoblins.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} Boko Shields are made of wood and will consequently burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They also float when dropped in water, and they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s like metal Shields do. If scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]], the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Boko Shield. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_004" |Life = 5 |GuardPower = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 1 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 2 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 2 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 6 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Boko Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 5 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = |buoyant = Yes |conductive = |guardian = }} Boko Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Boko Shields can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Boko Club]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Boko Shield Model.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}A Boko Shield ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bokoblin Gear * Dragonbone Boko Shield * Shield * Spiked Boko Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bokoblin Gear, Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
